methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Maier et al. adaptation)
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: The Snapdragon 8 Elite processor ensures top-notch performance for any workload, making it perfect for study and daily multitasking. The 2K AMOLED display and 6000mAh battery with 100W charging provide a seamless experience, ideal for long hours of work and classes.
construct_responses.EE: The interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, even for someone with moderate tech comfort. The learning curve is minimal, allowing for quick adaptation to the phone's features.
construct_responses.HM: The high-grade camera and large display make it a joy to use for video streaming and gaming. The 200MP periscope camera and 2K AMOLED screen offer fantastic visuals and a rich gaming experience.
construct_responses.SI: My college friends and peers would be impressed by the premium build quality and advanced features. It's a statement device that adds to my social status.
construct_responses.PP: The built-in security features give me peace of mind knowing my personal data is protected. The long-term software support also adds to the overall confidence in the device's security.
construct_responses.BI: I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone; the premium build quality, flagship processor, and display match everything I need. The price fits comfortably within my budget and I definitely intend to keep using it.
construct_responses.OVERALL: This phone is a perfect fit for my needs as a student, offering everything I require in a flagship device. The premium build and advanced features make it a worthwhile investment.
